name: pip-writing
description:
Writes performance improvement plans with specific behavioral expectations,
measurable goals, support resources, evaluation timeline, and consequences
for HR-compliant performance management. Use when the user needs to document
a performance improvement plan for an underperforming employee. Do NOT use
for general feedback (use `professional-email`), rejection letters (use
`rejection-letter`), or conflict resolution (use `conflict-resolution-email`).
